tasks.task_name: Establish project team structure with defined roles
tasks.description:
Set up the core project team structure as specified in the requirements. The team should consist of 4-5 people with clearly defined roles: 1 Product Manager, 1 Technical Lead, 2 Backend/CLI Developers, and 1 Quality Assurance engineer.

This task involves:
- Documenting the team hierarchy and reporting structure
- Identifying and recruiting team members for each role
- Establishing communication channels and collaboration workflows
- Defining handoff processes between roles

The team structure forms the foundation for all project activities and ensures clear accountability for different aspects of the CLI tool development.
tasks.task_notes: This is a foundational organizational task that should be completed early in the project lifecycle. Consider team availability, skill sets, and project timeline when staffing roles.

requirement_snippets:
### **6.1 Core Team Structure**
```
Project Team (4-5 people)
├── Product Manager (1)
├── Technical Lead (1)
├── Backend/CLI Developer (2)
└── Quality Assurance (1)
```
success_criteria: Team consists of 4-5 people
All five role categories are filled (Product Manager, Technical Lead, Backend/CLI Developers, Quality Assurance)
Team structure documentation is complete and accessible

tasks.task_name: Define and document Product Manager responsibilities and deliverables
tasks.description:
Establish comprehensive responsibilities and deliverables for the Product Manager role as specified in the requirements. The Product Manager is responsible for defining and prioritizing the feature roadmap, gathering user requirements and feedback, coordinating between stakeholders and the development team, managing project timeline and milestones, ensuring business requirements are met, and creating user documentation and marketing materials.

This task involves:
- Documenting all responsibilities in a role definition document
- Creating templates and processes for MVP deliverables
- Establishing feedback collection mechanisms
- Setting up stakeholder communication frameworks

The Product Manager deliverables for MVP include: user stories and acceptance criteria, MVP scope definition, user testing plan, and go-to-market strategy for CLI tool.

responsibilities: Coordinate between stakeholders and development team

tasks.task_notes: This role is critical for product-market fit and ensuring the CLI tool meets actual user needs. The Product Manager should be onboarded early and work closely with the Technical Lead on prioritization decisions.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.1 Product Manager**
**Responsibilities:**
- Define and prioritize feature roadmap
- Gather user requirements and feedback
- Coordinate between stakeholders and development team
- Manage project timeline and milestones
- Ensure business requirements are met
- User documentation and marketing materials

**MVP Deliverables:**
- User stories and acceptance criteria
- MVP scope definition
- User testing plan
- Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool
success_criteria: All six Product Manager responsibilities are documented and assigned
All four MVP deliverables are defined with clear completion criteria (user stories and acceptance criteria, MVP scope definition, user testing plan, go-to-market strategy)
Product Manager has established processes for gathering user requirements and feedback
Stakeholder coordination mechanisms are in place
dependencies: Establish project team structure with defined roles

tasks.task_name: Define and document Technical Lead responsibilities and deliverables
tasks.description:
Establish comprehensive responsibilities and deliverables for the Technical Lead role as specified in the requirements. The Technical Lead is responsible for architecture design and technical decisions, code review and quality standards, implementation of core modules, integration with Notion API, performance and security oversight, and mentoring other developers.

This task involves:
- Documenting all responsibilities in a role definition document
- Establishing code review processes and quality standards
- Creating architecture documentation templates
- Defining security and performance benchmarks
- Setting up mentoring and knowledge-sharing processes

The Technical Lead will be central to ensuring the technical excellence of the CLI tool and the integration with Notion API.
tasks.task_notes: The Technical Lead role is critical for technical quality and architectural coherence. This person should be identified early and involved in all major technical decisions. The Notion API integration responsibility suggests this role requires specific API expertise or the ability to quickly learn it.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.2 Technical Lead**
**Responsibilities:**
- Architecture design and technical decisions
- Code review and quality standards
- Implementation of core modules
- Integration with Notion API
- Performance and security oversight
- Mentoring other developers
success_criteria: All six Technical Lead responsibilities are documented and assigned
Code review processes and quality standards are established
Architecture design documentation is in place
Notion API integration approach is defined
Performance and security oversight processes are established
Developer mentoring framework is set up
dependencies: Establish project team structure with defined roles

tasks.description:
Produce the four MVP deliverables specified for the Product Manager role: user stories and acceptance criteria, MVP scope definition, user testing plan, and go-to-market strategy for the CLI tool.

This task involves:
- Writing comprehensive user stories with clear acceptance criteria for all MVP features
- Defining the precise scope of the MVP, including what is in-scope and out-of-scope
- Developing a structured user testing plan with test scenarios, success metrics, and feedback collection methods
- Creating a go-to-market strategy that includes target audience, distribution channels, messaging, and launch timeline

These deliverables will guide the entire development process and ensure the CLI tool meets user needs and business objectives.

deliverables.name: User stories and acceptance criteria
deliverables.format: Document with user stories in standard format (As a [user], I want [feature], so that [benefit]) with measurable acceptance criteria

deliverables.name: MVP scope definition
deliverables.format: Document clearly delineating in-scope and out-of-scope features for MVP release

deliverables.name: User testing plan
deliverables.format: Structured plan including test scenarios, participant selection, feedback mechanisms, and success metrics

deliverables.name: Go-to-market strategy
deliverables.format: Strategy document covering target audience, distribution channels, messaging, and launch approach

tasks.task_notes: These deliverables are interdependent and should be developed iteratively. The user stories will inform the MVP scope, which will influence the testing plan and go-to-market strategy. Expect multiple rounds of refinement based on stakeholder feedback.

requirement_snippets:
**MVP Deliverables:**
- User stories and acceptance criteria
- MVP scope definition
- User testing plan
- Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool
success_criteria: User stories and acceptance criteria document is complete and reviewed
MVP scope definition document is finalized and approved by stakeholders
User testing plan is documented with clear test scenarios and metrics
Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool is complete and actionable
dependencies: Define and document Product Manager responsibilities and deliverables
Establish project team structure with defined roles

tasks.task_name: Establish code review and quality standards framework
tasks.description:
Implement the code review processes and quality standards as part of the Technical Lead's responsibilities. This framework will ensure consistent code quality across the CLI tool development.

This task involves:
- Defining code review workflow (e.g., pull request process, required approvals)
- Establishing coding standards and style guides
- Setting up automated linting and formatting tools
- Creating code review checklists and guidelines
- Defining quality metrics and gates (e.g., test coverage requirements)
- Documenting the review process for the team

This framework is essential for maintaining code quality as the Backend/CLI Developers implement features.
tasks.task_notes: This should be established early before significant implementation begins. The Technical Lead should collaborate with Backend/CLI Developers to ensure standards are practical and enforceable.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.2 Technical Lead**
**Responsibilities:**
- Architecture design and technical decisions
- Code review and quality standards
success_criteria: Code review workflow is documented and understood by all developers
Coding standards are documented and accessible
Automated quality tools are configured and integrated into development workflow
Quality metrics are defined and measurable
dependencies: Define and document Technical Lead responsibilities and deliverables

tasks.task_name: Design system architecture and make core technical decisions
tasks.description:
Fulfill the Technical Lead's responsibility for architecture design and technical decisions. This task involves creating the overall system architecture for the CLI tool and establishing key technical decisions that will guide implementation.

This task involves:
- Designing the CLI tool architecture (command structure, module organization, data flow)
- Selecting technology stack and frameworks
- Designing the Notion API integration approach
- Making decisions on data storage, configuration management, and error handling
- Creating architecture documentation and diagrams
- Defining module boundaries and interfaces

These architectural decisions will guide the Backend/CLI Developers during implementation.
tasks.task_notes: This is a high-priority task that must be completed before significant implementation work begins. The architecture should be reviewed with the Product Manager to ensure it aligns with MVP scope and user stories.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.2 Technical Lead**
**Responsibilities:**
- Architecture design and technical decisions
- Implementation of core modules
- Integration with Notion API
success_criteria: System architecture document is complete and reviewed
Architecture supports integration with Notion API
Technology stack decisions are documented with clear justification
Module boundaries and interfaces are clearly defined
Architecture documentation is accessible to all team members
dependencies: Define and document Technical Lead responsibilities and deliverables
Create Product Manager MVP deliverables

tasks.task_name: Implement performance and security oversight processes
tasks.description:
Establish performance and security oversight processes as part of the Technical Lead's responsibilities. This ensures the CLI tool meets performance requirements and follows security best practices.

This task involves:
- Defining performance benchmarks and acceptance criteria
- Setting up performance monitoring and profiling tools
- Establishing security review processes and checklists
- Creating security guidelines for Notion API integration (credential management, data protection)
- Implementing automated security scanning tools
- Documenting performance and security standards

Given the integration with Notion API, security considerations around API keys and user data are particularly important.

deliverables: Security guidelines for Notion API integration

tasks.task_notes: Performance and security should be considered from the beginning, not retrofitted. The Notion API integration requires careful handling of credentials. Consider implementing automated checks in CI/CD pipeline.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.2 Technical Lead**
**Responsibilities:**
- Performance and security oversight
success_criteria: Performance benchmarks are defined and measurable
Security review process is documented and integrated into development workflow
Automated security scanning tools are configured and running
Security guidelines for Notion API integration are documented
Performance monitoring is in place
dependencies: Define and document Technical Lead responsibilities and deliverables
Design system architecture and make core technical decisions

tasks.task_name: Establish developer mentoring and knowledge-sharing framework
tasks.description:
Set up mentoring and knowledge-sharing processes as part of the Technical Lead's responsibilities. This ensures effective skill development and knowledge transfer within the team, particularly to the Backend/CLI Developers.

This task involves:
- Creating a mentoring framework and schedule
- Establishing knowledge-sharing sessions (e.g., tech talks, pair programming)
- Setting up documentation practices for knowledge capture
- Creating onboarding materials for new team members
- Defining technical growth paths for developers

Effective mentoring will accelerate team productivity and code quality.
tasks.task_notes: While important, this can be established after initial architecture and standards are in place. The Technical Lead should adapt the mentoring approach based on the specific needs and experience levels of the Backend/CLI Developers.

success_criteria: Mentoring framework is documented and communicated to team
Knowledge-sharing sessions are scheduled and occurring regularly
Technical onboarding materials are available
Developers report effective mentoring and knowledge transfer
dependencies: Define and document Technical Lead responsibilities and deliverables
Establish project team structure with defined roles

tasks.task_name: Implement core modules led by Technical Lead
tasks.description:
Execute the Technical Lead's responsibility to implement core modules of the CLI tool. The Technical Lead will personally implement critical, foundational modules that set the standard for code quality and establish architectural patterns.

This task involves:
- Identifying which modules are considered 'core' based on MVP scope
- Implementing foundational modules (e.g., CLI framework, configuration management, core utilities)
- Establishing coding patterns and best practices through implementation examples
- Creating reusable components for Backend/CLI Developers
- Documenting module interfaces and usage

The Technical Lead's direct implementation work provides concrete examples of architecture in practice.
tasks.task_notes: This task should begin after architecture is designed but can overlap with other implementation work. The Technical Lead should prioritize implementing the most foundational modules first to unblock Backend/CLI Developers.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.2 Technical Lead**
**Responsibilities:**
- Implementation of core modules
success_criteria: Core modules are implemented and functional
Core modules pass code quality standards and tests
Module interfaces are documented
Implementation demonstrates architectural principles and best practices
dependencies: Design system architecture and make core technical decisions
Establish code review and quality standards framework

tasks.task_name: Design and implement Notion API integration
tasks.description:
Execute the Technical Lead's responsibility for integration with Notion API. This is a critical component of the CLI tool that enables interaction with Notion workspaces.

This task involves:
- Researching Notion API capabilities and limitations
- Designing the integration architecture (authentication, API client, data models)
- Implementing Notion API client with proper error handling and rate limiting
- Creating abstractions for Notion API operations
- Implementing secure credential management for Notion API keys
- Testing API integration thoroughly
- Documenting API integration for other developers

The Notion API integration is likely central to the CLI tool's functionality and requires careful design and implementation.
tasks.task_notes: This is a critical, high-priority task. The Notion API has specific authentication requirements, rate limits, and data models that must be understood. Consider creating mock/test modes for development without hitting real Notion API. Security of API credentials is paramount.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.2 Technical Lead**
**Responsibilities:**
- Integration with Notion API
success_criteria: Notion API client is implemented and functional
API authentication is working securely
API integration passes all integration tests
Rate limiting and error handling are properly implemented
API credentials are managed securely
Integration documentation is complete
dependencies: Design system architecture and make core technical decisions
Implement performance and security oversight processes

tasks.task_name: Create feature roadmap and prioritization framework
tasks.description:
Fulfill the Product Manager's responsibility to define and prioritize the feature roadmap. This task creates a structured approach to feature planning and prioritization for the CLI tool.

This task involves:
- Creating a feature roadmap spanning MVP and future releases
- Establishing prioritization criteria (e.g., user value, implementation complexity, dependencies)
- Setting up a backlog management system
- Defining release planning process
- Creating feature request evaluation framework

The feature roadmap provides visibility into the product direction and helps coordinate development efforts.
tasks.task_notes: The roadmap should be living document that evolves based on user feedback and technical discoveries. Prioritization should balance user value with technical feasibility and be reviewed regularly with the Technical Lead.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.1 Product Manager**
**Responsibilities:**
- Define and prioritize feature roadmap
success_criteria: Feature roadmap is documented and accessible to team
Prioritization framework is defined and applied consistently
Backlog is organized and prioritized
Release planning process is established
dependencies: Define and document Product Manager responsibilities and deliverables
Create Product Manager MVP deliverables

tasks.task_name: Establish user requirements and feedback collection system
tasks.description:
Implement the Product Manager's responsibility to gather user requirements and feedback. This system ensures continuous input from users throughout the CLI tool development.

This task involves:
- Setting up feedback collection channels (e.g., surveys, user interviews, feedback forms)
- Creating user research processes and templates
- Establishing a system for tracking and analyzing feedback
- Defining how feedback influences roadmap and priorities
- Setting up regular user touchpoints
- Creating feedback loop with development team

Effective feedback collection is critical for ensuring the CLI tool meets actual user needs.
tasks.task_notes: Start with a simple feedback system and iterate. Consider both qualitative (interviews, open feedback) and quantitative (surveys, usage metrics) approaches. Ensure feedback is actionable and fed back to the team regularly.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.1 Product Manager**
**Responsibilities:**
- Gather user requirements and feedback
success_criteria: Feedback collection channels are established and publicized
User research processes are documented
Feedback is being collected regularly
Feedback analysis framework is in place and producing insights
Feedback influences product decisions demonstrably
dependencies: Define and document Product Manager responsibilities and deliverables

tasks.task_name: Establish stakeholder coordination and project management processes
tasks.description:
Implement the Product Manager's responsibilities for coordinating between stakeholders and the development team, and managing project timeline and milestones. This task creates the project management infrastructure.

This task involves:
- Identifying all project stakeholders
- Establishing stakeholder communication cadence (e.g., weekly updates, demos)
- Setting up project management tools and dashboards
- Defining project milestones and timeline
- Creating status reporting processes
- Establishing decision-making and escalation processes

Effective coordination ensures alignment between business needs and technical implementation.
tasks.task_notes: Stakeholder coordination should begin early and maintain momentum throughout the project. The Product Manager should balance stakeholder input with team capacity and MVP scope constraints.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.1 Product Manager**
**Responsibilities:**
- Coordinate between stakeholders and development team
- Manage project timeline and milestones
success_criteria: All stakeholders are identified and mapped
Communication cadence is established and maintained
Project management tools are configured and in use
Project timeline and milestones are documented and tracked
Status reporting is occurring regularly
Decision-making processes are clear and functioning
dependencies: Define and document Product Manager responsibilities and deliverables
Establish project team structure with defined roles

tasks.task_name: Create user documentation and marketing materials
tasks.description:
Fulfill the Product Manager's responsibility for creating user documentation and marketing materials for the CLI tool. This makes the tool accessible and attractive to target users.

This task involves:
- Writing comprehensive user documentation (installation, usage, commands, examples)
- Creating getting-started guides and tutorials
- Developing marketing materials (landing page content, feature descriptions, use cases)
- Creating demo videos or screenshots
- Writing API reference documentation
- Preparing release notes and changelog templates

High-quality documentation and marketing materials are essential for user adoption.

deliverables: User documentation (README, user guide, command reference)

tasks.task_notes: Documentation should be created iteratively as features are implemented. Marketing materials should align with the go-to-market strategy. Consider using the CLI tool itself to generate documentation examples.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.1 Product Manager**
**Responsibilities:**
- User documentation and marketing materials
success_criteria: User documentation covers all CLI commands and features
Getting-started guide enables new users to quickly begin using the tool
Marketing materials clearly communicate value proposition
Demo materials effectively showcase CLI tool capabilities
Documentation is clear, accurate, and accessible
dependencies: Create Product Manager MVP deliverables
Design and implement Notion API integration

tasks.task_name: Ensure business requirements validation and acceptance
tasks.description:
Fulfill the Product Manager's responsibility to ensure business requirements are met. This task establishes validation processes to confirm the CLI tool meets its business objectives.

This task involves:
- Creating business requirement validation checklist
- Establishing acceptance criteria for business goals
- Setting up metrics to measure business value (e.g., user adoption, satisfaction, business impact)
- Conducting business requirement review sessions
- Validating that technical implementation aligns with business needs
- Creating business acceptance test plans

This ensures the CLI tool delivers actual business value, not just technical functionality.
tasks.task_notes: Business validation should occur throughout development, not just at the end. The Product Manager should work with stakeholders to define what 'success' means in business terms and validate against those criteria.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.1 Product Manager**
**Responsibilities:**
- Ensure business requirements are met
success_criteria: Business requirements are clearly defined and documented
Validation checklist is complete and applied
Business metrics are defined and measurable
Regular validation reviews confirm alignment with business goals
Business acceptance criteria are met for MVP
dependencies: Create Product Manager MVP deliverables
Establish stakeholder coordination and project management processes
